description: This file defines a Java interface 'FixedDepositProductWritePlatformService' which specifies methods for creating, updating, and deleting fixed deposit products within the Fineract project.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductWritePlatformService
classes.description: A service interface for handling write operations related to fixed deposit products in the Fineract system.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new fixed deposit product based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing fixed deposit product identified by productId with the data provided in JsonCommand.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the fixed deposit product identified by productId.
